Eva: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4712 — small change: per-model KV TTL + early-batcher bail when sub-batch size < threshold. Can someone take a quick look? aiming to merge today if tests pass. tl;dr reduces tail latency on short interactive queries.

Sam: quick q — is TTL in seconds or tokens? and does expiration refresh on access or is it absolute?

Eva: TTL is seconds from write (fixed). Config key is `kv_cache.ttl_seconds`. Example:```yaml
models:
  /gpt-small:
    kv_cache:
      enabled: true
      ttl_seconds: 300
```
Access does NOT refresh TTL (no sliding window) — we chose fixed to avoid read amplification under hotspotting.

Maria: can you paste perf numbers? specifically p95/p99 delta for short queries (32 tokens) and for longer sequences (~4k)?

Eva: ran a quick microbench on the dev cluster (g4dn, 8GPU):
- baseline p95 (short ~32 tokens): 74ms
- with kv-ttl + fast-bail batcher: 48ms (-35%)
- baseline p99: 120ms -> 78ms
Long sequences (4k) throughput roughly unchanged; small variance within noise. log artifact: `bench/kvs_ttl_bail_2026-11-02.log` (internal link).

Ryan: rollout plan? need a safe canary + easy rollback if we see regressions. also what's the default threshold for the early bail?

Eva: rollout plan in the PR: canary 10% traffic to `gpt-small@v2-kvttl` for 2h, monitor p95/p99 and error rate, then 50% -> 100%. Fallback rule: revert to `v1` on >=1% error spike or latency increase >20% sustained 5m. early-bail threshold is 4 tokens by default, configurable via `batcher.min_subbatch_size`.

DeployBot: CI results: unit tests 125 passed, integration 18 passed, e2e smoke ok. Docker build succeeded.

Sam: left two inline comments about a potential race in `kv.get_or_insert` (concurrent writer path) and a logging nit. not blocking, but worth addressing.

Sam: posted suggestions. not blocking.

Maria: small docs ask: please add a note in `docs/ops/kv_cache.md` describing TTL semantics (fixed vs sliding) and example config snippet.

Eva: I can add the docs commit after merge if you prefer, or push it now as part of this PR. I can do either.

Ryan: prefer docs in the same PR if it's tiny. otherwise ok to follow up. if Sam marks non-blocking then +1 from me to merge after docs. :thumbsup:

Sam: fixed the race, pushed a tiny change, re-ran tests.

Sam: LGTM.

Eva: thanks everyone — I'll merge in 10m unless someone yells. will start canary and paste the dashboard link here once live.
